name: Air Fryer Black Bean Burgers with Potato Wedges

components.name: Black Bean Patties

ingredients.name: Canned cooked black beans, thoroughly drained
Raw beaten whole egg without shell
Chipotle chili in adobo with vegetarian label
Olive oil for air fryer brushing

steps: Drain beans extremely well and mash coarsely with grated onion, garlic, chipotle, soy and cumin; retain some chunks for texture.
Fold in beaten egg and panko until patties hold their shape. Shape six burgers and refrigerate at least 20 minutes to firm.
Brush bean patties lightly with remaining measured oil and air fry at 190 C for 12-16 minutes, turning gently, until hot through and firm; do not stack.
Freeze formed cooked patties separately from buns and potato wedges; lettuce and fresh tomato should never be frozen.

components.name: Potato Wedges
steps: Toss raw potato wedges with oil and spices, air fry 195 C for 18-25 minutes, shaking midway; cook in batches.

components.name: Bun & Toppings
steps: Warm burger buns, then assemble with tomato and lettuce only at serving time.
